fields.label: Outcome
fields.description: Observable result delivered by this pull request.

fields.label: Compatibility
fields.description: Compatibility and migration impact, or none.

fields.label: Stack
fields.description: Dependencies on other pull requests, or none.

fields.label: Completion receipt
fields.description: Completion receipt digest, or pending while draft.

fields.label: Verdict
fields.description: Actual independent review outcome, or pending while draft.

fields.label: Non-blocking dispositions
fields.description: Resolution, or owner plus durable HTTPS record.

checks.label: Accepted scope is implemented without silent expansion.
Required profiles pass on the reviewed snapshot.
Independent review approved with no blocking finding.
Every non-blocking finding has a recorded disposition.

rules.guidance:
Report outcomes only. Keep reviewer actor/context IDs and local run paths in lifecycle state. List every non-blocking disposition; accepted-risk and tracked-follow-up entries need an owner and durable HTTPS record.
The author/coordinator fills known contract facts and then actual verification, review and completion results. Draft placeholders are not completed evidence.
Producer/intermediate PR: Refs ISSUE. Final verified consumer adoption only: Closes ISSUE, closes OWNER/REPOSITORY#NUMBER. Repeat the closing keyword for every issue; put the reference after the completed checklist.
